professional.title: Professional
professional.body: AI-accelerated developer with deep platform knowledge and 10+ years of experience shipping production-grade Android, iOS, and backend systems across crypto, fintech, streaming, telecom, e-commerce, and transport. I pair high-output execution with composable architectures, mentoring, and clean, testable code that scales.

personal.title: Personal
personal.body: Husband. Dad. Explorer. When I’m not shipping mobile features, I’m outside with an 8-inch Dobsonian watching Saturn’s rings, or planning the next family trip with my camera in tow. I read philosophy and anything that stretches my thinking, and I run a small Airbnb plus a laundry venture—practical experiments on the road to financial independence. Fitness keeps me honest; curiosity keeps me moving.
